metadata.title: The Merveilles Country
metadata.instructions: To add a place, duplicate any Feature, give it a unique id, and change its name, coordinates, description, category, and links. Coordinates are [longitude, latitude].

properties.name: Renaissance Faire
properties.subtitle: The northern revels
properties.description: The Colorado Renaissance Festival grounds in Larkspur—the northern threshold of this regional chart.

properties.name: Merveilles
properties.subtitle: The garden of marvels
properties.description: An intentionally approximate public marker for Merveilles Pleasure Gardens. Exact guest arrival directions remain private.

properties.name: Palmer Lake
properties.subtitle: The waters between two realms
properties.description: The historic lake and town at the crest of the Palmer Divide, draining toward both the Platte and Arkansas watersheds.

properties.name: Palmer Lake Troll
properties.subtitle: The metal legend beneath the bridge
properties.description: Palmer Lake’s community-built metal troll, unveiled in June 2026. The marker is approximate pending a surveyed public coordinate.

properties.name: Elephant Rock
properties.subtitle: The eastern stone
properties.description: A distinctive sandstone summit and arch east of Palmer Lake, recorded in the USGS place-name data.

properties.name: The Chautauqua
properties.subtitle: Glen Park’s tent university
properties.description: The historic Chautauqua grounds around Glen Park and Chautauqua Avenue, where summer lectures, music, walks, and tent lodging once gathered visitors.

properties.name: Ice Cave Creek
properties.subtitle: The hidden cold passage
properties.description: A steep forested trail system west of Palmer Lake following Ice Cave Creek toward the Rampart Range wildlands.

properties.name: Chautauqua Mountain
properties.subtitle: The western overlook
properties.description: A wooded summit above Palmer Lake and the historic Chautauqua grounds.

properties.name: Balanced Rock
properties.subtitle: The western stone
properties.description: The Balanced Rock trail country west of Palmer Lake, shown here at the named USGS trail feature.

properties.name: Raspberry Mountain
properties.subtitle: The berry-crowned height
properties.description: A Rampart Range summit west of Monument, near the Raspberry Mountain trail network.

properties.name: Monument Rock
properties.subtitle: The southern sentinel
properties.description: The named sandstone summit west of Monument, listed on the USGS Palmer Lake quadrangle.

properties.name: Mount Herman
properties.subtitle: The high southern watch
properties.description: The prominent Rampart Range summit overlooking Monument and the Palmer Divide.

properties.name: Harrison Crash Trail
properties.subtitle: A mountain memorial
properties.description: A general map marker for the long Ice Cave Creek route to Captain Sidney Harrison’s 1952 crash site. It is deliberately not presented as a navigation coordinate; visitors should use a current official trail map and respect the wreckage.
